statements.t: Our defense business is becoming an increasingly important part of this strategy, supported by just under $1.0 million in recently secured new orders, additional expected defense opportunities are now progressing through the award contracting process, and ongoing production and next-generation development work with Collins Aerospace.

Total operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were $7.6 million and included approximately $1.0 million of external consulting costs related to the Vuzix Causeway platform, which the Company does not expect to recur.

Excluding these costs, operating expenses were approximately $6.6 million, approximately 7% below the third quarter of 2025, and the Company expects fourth-quarter operating expenses to be in the mid-$6 million range.

The third quarter included approximately $1.0 million of external market assessment and consulting costs that we do not expect to recur, and we expect to continue advancing Causeway without a significant increase in development spending.

A live and archived webcast of the conference call will be available on the investor relations page of the Company's website at: https://ir.vuzix.com/ or directly at https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=o9t06kZp

As a percentage of total sales, such costs increased to 111% compared to 44% in 2025 due to lower product revenue, the reworking of older product versions into upgraded current versions, which did not result in any additional overhead absorption, and lower production levels of new product, as the Company has sufficient finished goods on hand to meet currently expected demand for current Smart Glasses models for…

As a percentage of total sales, such costs increased to 61%, compared to 40% in 2025, due to lower product revenue, the reworking of older product versions into upgraded current versions, which did not result in any additional overhead absorption, and lower production levels of new product, as the Company has sufficient finished goods on hand to meet currently expected demand for current Smart Glasses models for…
The Company’s cash requirements going forward are primarily for funding operating losses, research and development, working capital and investments in fixed assets, patents, and trademarks.
The Company’s management intends to take actions necessary to continue as a going concern, as discussed herein.

Management’s plans to alleviate the conditions that raise substantial doubt include raising further capital, the implementation of operational improvements, and the curtailment of certain development programs, all of which the Company expects will preserve cash.

Management will continue to utilize the available “at the market” facility noted above to satisfy obligations as they become due, as well as, monitor the capital markets on an ongoing basis and may consider raising capital under other programs if favorable market conditions develop.
However, management can make no assurance that the Company will be able to successfully complete any of the aforementioned pursuits on terms acceptable to the Company, or at all.
